 1899 Battle::AbilityEffects::OnBeingHit.add(:MUMMY,
 1900   proc { |ability, user, target, move, battle|
 1901     next if !move.pbContactMove?(user)
 1902     next if user.fainted?
 1903     next if user.unstoppableAbility? || user.ability == ability
 1904     oldAbil = nil
 1905     battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(target) if user.opposes?(target)
 1906     if user.affectedByContactEffect?(Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH)
 1907       oldAbil = user.ability
 1908       battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(user, true, false) if user.opposes?(target)
 1909       user.ability = ability
 1910       battle.pbReplaceAbilitySplash(user) if user.opposes?(target)
 1911       if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
 1912         battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s Ability became {2}!", user.pbThis, user.abilityName))
 1913       else
 1914         battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s Ability became {2} because of {3}!",
 1915            user.pbThis, user.abilityName, target.pbThis(true)))
 1916       end
 1917       battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(user) if user.opposes?(target)
 1918     end
 1919     battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(target) if user.opposes?(target)
 1920     user.pbOnLosingAbility(oldAbil)
 1921     user.pbTriggerAbilityOnGainingIt
 1922   }
 1923 )
